async def act(page):
    """
    Continue from the current New Rule page and finish creating the Pride Month - 45% Off catalog price rule.
    Actions performed:
    - Close the visible popup if present
    - Ensure all Customer Groups are selected (applies rule to all customers)
    - Open the Actions tab
    - Set Apply = "By Percentage of the Original Price"
    - Set Discount Amount = 45 (fill every matching textbox to avoid strict-mode issues)
    - Click "Save and Apply" as the final action (navigates away)

    Notes about knowledge_base functions: none are available in the environment, so all interactions
    use Playwright APIs directly (get_by_role, get_by_label, select_option, nth, etc.).
    """
    import asyncio

    # 0) Knowledge-base functions utility reasoning:
    # There are no Python functions provided in the knowledge base for this task, so none are used.

    # 1) Close the popup if present. Try several common accessible names for the close button.
    for close_name in ("Close", "close", "×", "X", "Dismiss", "OK"):
        try:
            btn = page.get_by_role("button", name=close_name)
            if await btn.count() > 0:
                await btn.first.click()
                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
                break
        except Exception:
            # ignore and try the next candidate
            pass

    # 2) Select all Customer Groups so the rule applies to all customers
    try:
        cust_groups = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Customer Groups *")
        if await cust_groups.count() > 0:
            await cust_groups.first.select_option([
                {"label": "NOT LOGGED IN"},
                {"label": "General"},
                {"label": "Wholesale"},
                {"label": "VIP Member"},
                {"label": "Private Sales Member"},
            ])
            await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
    except Exception:
        # continue even if selection fails
        pass

    # 3) Open the Actions tab/section to access discount fields
    try:
        actions_tab = page.get_by_role("link", name="Actions")
        if await actions_tab.count() > 0:
            await actions_tab.first.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.18)
        else:
            # fallback: sometimes the link label may be slightly different
            actions_tab2 = page.get_by_role("link", name="Action")
            if await actions_tab2.count() > 0:
                await actions_tab2.first.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
                await asyncio.sleep(0.18)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 4) Set Apply to "By Percentage of the Original Price"
    try:
        apply_box = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Apply")
        if await apply_box.count() > 0:
            await apply_box.first.select_option(label="By Percentage of the Original Price")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 5) Fill Discount Amount = 45. Fill every matching textbox to avoid strict-mode violations.
    try:
        discount_boxes = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Discount Amount")
        cnt = await discount_boxes.count()
        if cnt == 0:
            # fallback to label-based locator if role-based didn't find any
            discount_boxes = page.get_by_label("Discount Amount")
            cnt = await discount_boxes.count()
        for i in range(cnt):
            await discount_boxes.nth(i).fill("45")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.06)
    except Exception:
        pass

    await asyncio.sleep(0.18)

    # 6) Final action: click "Save and Apply" (preferred) or fall back to "Save". This will navigate away.
    try:
        save_apply = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save and Apply")
        if await save_apply.count() > 0:
            await save_apply.first.click()
            return
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        save_btn = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save")
        if await save_btn.count() > 0:
            await save_btn.first.click()
            return
    except Exception:
        pass

    # If no save control found, finish without navigation
    return

                await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
                break
        except Exception:
            # ignore and try the next candidate
            pass

    try:
        cust_groups = page.get_by_role("listbox", name="Customer Groups *")

            await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
    except Exception:

        pass

    try:
        actions_tab = page.get_by_role("link", name="Actions")
        if await actions_tab.count() > 0:

                await asyncio.sleep(0.18)
    except Exception:
        pass

            await asyncio.sleep(0.12)
